name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: A countdown whose digits drop in as they change; at zero the tiles step back for a Live pill with a beating dot.

perf.budget: One timer per second re-renders a few text cells; each changed digit animates two texts. Once live, only the dot loops.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the seconds tick once a second. A finished countdown only loops the dot.

a11y.reducedMotion: Digits change in place and the live dot holds still.
a11y.screenReader: A timer that reads the time left in words, then the live label.
